name: unsafe fn disconnect_receivers (& self) -> bool
rule: Before calling `disconnect_receivers`, the destruction of all other receivers must have been observed with acquire ordering or stronger.
api: impl < T > std::sync::mpmc::array::Channel < T > { unsafe fn disconnect_receivers (& self) -> bool }
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it has no observation for prior receiver destruction or the acquire-or-stronger ordering with which it was observed.
